doc.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Closing: great music is great music
summary: Rowe plans a second part; Buckingham closes by saying it is only good or bad music.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I want to tell you I’ve really enjoyed this conversation.
I know you have some people waiting for you.
I don’t think it’s anything but dinner.
So we’ll book Part Two down the — conversation down the road.

I hope I’m going to be back, but this is good, and it’s good to talk to somebody who knows it, understands it, and I’m not talking about, again, jazz — I love jazz, I played, I produced jazz artists. I love great country music. I love great rhythm & blues. I love great pop music. Like Duke Ellington said, it’s only great music. It’s either good or it’s bad. It doesn’t matter what you label it. It’s good or bad. And I appreciate the fact that you understand that.
Well on that note, thanks a lot. Appreciate it.
